name: Turn a Google Doc into a slide deck with Gamma after outline approval
description: Run it with a Google Doc ID, the audience and a rough slide count. An AI agent reads the document and drafts a slide-by-slide outline: one idea per slide, a title and three to five bullets each, with nothing invented beyond the source. A person edits and approves the outline, then Gamma generates the presentation from it, and when it is ready the deck link is emailed to you.
shortDescription: Approve an outline drawn from your doc, then let Gamma build the deck.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the deck-from-docs skill and the Google Docs Get Document tool
Outline-first: nothing is created until the outline is approved, and it stays editable
Gamma generates the deck from the approved outline with the Gamma Generate Presentation action
No invented data, quotes or charts; cut content listed for review
prerequisites: The `deck-from-docs` skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the SKILL.md in the blue canvas note
Google Docs and Google Mail (Gmail) connection
Gamma connection with an API key, on a Gamma plan with API access
idealFor: Anyone who has the content in a doc and needs a presentation without building slides by hand.
steps: Trigger: run the workflow manually with the Google Doc ID, audience, slide count and your email address.
Draft the outline: the AI Agent loads the deck-from-docs skill, reads the doc and writes a slide-by-slide outline.
Approve: the run pauses until a reviewer edits and approves the outline.
Approved: start a Gamma generation from the outline, wait for it and read the result.
Email the deck link, or the status if Gamma is not done yet.
Rejected: log the comment and create nothing.
